// diagnostic

E-FENCE-SPELLING

`{old}` is the retired fence spelling.

What

`{old}` is the retired fence spelling.

Why

Statement-expansion fences are spelled `<: … :>`; prefix `@` belongs to compile-time marks.

Fix

Replace `{old}` with `{new}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-FENCE-SPELLING: tests/ui/fenced_name_retired_spelling.stderr.

Error [E-FENCE-SPELLING]: `@[` is the retired fence spelling.
  --> tests/ui/fenced_name_retired_spelling.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     @[ first, second ]@ :: 1
    |     ^^
 Why: Statement-expansion fences are spelled `<: … :>`; prefix `@` belongs to compile-time marks.
 Fix: Replace `@[` with `<:`.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E-FENCE-SPELLING
